_meta.title: TriageWiseProdrome — lede rendering cases (req 1.9)
_meta.validates: The lede render step (in getPatientDetail / TriageService) — structured stored data -> the summary sentence(s) at the top of the patient detail. Deterministic: same inputs -> identical text.
_meta.nature: The lede is built at read time from STORED data, NOT from a live SeverityResult. Inputs mirror what getPatientDetail actually reads: patient_severity fields + ai_explanation.factor_breakdown + ai_explanation.data_completeness.
_meta.how_to_use: For each case: feed inputs to _render_lede, assert the output EQUALS expected_lede exactly (deterministic). Component fields (score, esi, band_name, n_vital, vital_clause) are provided for targeted assertions but expected_lede is the source of truth.

inputs_shape.from_patient_severity: severity_score (int), system_ESI (e.g. 'ESI-3'), fallbacks_applied (list; read for the non-5/5 tail)
inputs_shape.from_ai_explanation: factor_breakdown (list[Driver dicts]) + data_completeness + gaps (dict; the non-5/5 coverage tail reads gaps['assumed'] / gaps['not_provided'])
inputs_shape.derived: band_name via ESI->label map; n_vital = len(factor_breakdown) - 1 (exactly one complaint driver always present)

conventions: n_vital = len(factor_breakdown) - 1 (one complaint driver always fires).
vital clause uses DIGITS: n_vital==1 -> '1 vital-sign rule'; n_vital>=2 -> '{n} vital-sign rules'; n_vital==0 -> 'the chief-complaint rule alone.' (no vital clause).

largest-contributor clause (n_drivers>=2): drivers sorted by contribution_pct desc; the chief-complaint driver renders its THRESHOLD (readable phrase, e.g. 'shortness of breath'), vitals render their FACTOR. '{top}; {rest} add(s) to the total.'
band_name from LABEL_MAP (ESI-1 Critical ... ESI-5 Non-urgent).

coverage: data_completeness=='5 of 5' -> 'All required vitals provided.'; else '{dc} vitals scored - {groups}.' where groups are '; '-joined, each group ', '-joined VITAL_RENDER display names, order: assumed group then missing group, empty groups omitted.

VITAL_RENDER maps column->display: oxygen_saturation->SpO2, heart_rate->Heart rate, respiration_rate->Respiratory rate, blood_pressure_systolic->Systolic BP, pain_level->Pain score, temperature->Temperature, blood_pressure_diastolic->Diastolic BP, blood_sugar->Blood sugar.
assumed vs missing: gaps['assumed'] render as '... assumed'; gaps['not_provided'] as '... missing'. Both assume_normal and assume_zero live in gaps['assumed'] and render identically as 'assumed'.

cases._why: n_vital = 1 (2 drivers - 1 complaint) must render singular 'one vital-sign rule'. Maria case.

expect.expected_lede: This patient scored 5 points -> ESI-3 (Urgent) from 1 vital-sign rule and the chief-complaint rule. The largest contributor is shortness of breath; Heart rate adds to the total. 2 of 5 vitals scored - SpO2 assumed; Respiratory rate, Systolic BP missing.

cases._why: n_vital = 4 (5 drivers - 1 complaint) must render 'four vital-sign rules' (plural, spelled). Robert case.

expect.expected_lede: This patient scored 14 points -> ESI-1 (Critical) from 3 vital-sign rules and the chief-complaint rule. The largest contributor is chest pain (cardiac concern); SpO2, Heart rate, Respiratory rate add to the total. All required vitals provided.

cases._why: n_vital = 0 (1 driver, complaint only). No vital clause at all — 'from the chief-complaint rule' alone.

expect.expected_lede: This patient scored 6 points -> ESI-2 (Emergent) from the chief-complaint rule alone. 0 of 5 vitals scored - SpO2, Pain score assumed; Heart rate, Respiratory rate, Systolic BP missing.

cases._why: n_vital = 2 (3 drivers - 1) -> 'two vital-sign rules'. Checks the spelled plural for the common case.

expect.expected_lede: This patient scored 9 points -> ESI-1 (Critical) from 2 vital-sign rules and the chief-complaint rule. The largest contributor is chest pain (cardiac concern); Heart rate, SpO2 add to the total. All required vitals provided.

cases._why: Band label map: ESI-3 -> Urgent. Guards the ESI->name derivation independently.

expect.expected_lede: This patient scored 4 points -> ESI-3 (Urgent) from 1 vital-sign rule and the chief-complaint rule. The largest contributor is abdominal pain; Heart rate adds to the total. All required vitals provided.

cases._why: ESI-5 -> Non-urgent, the least-acute label. Complaint-only, n_vital 0.

expect.expected_lede: This patient scored 0 points -> ESI-5 (Non-urgent) from the chief-complaint rule alone. All required vitals provided.
